items.text: Also welcome to all the new players who have joined us lately, thanks for your support and all the reviews!

We have been busy gathering player feedback and bringing improvements and refinements to Mad Games Tycoon 2 and we're here to highlight some of the most recent changes to the game, with the latest patch coming out today.
Overall, there have been about 40 changes implemented thanks directly to feedback from the community and we are continuing to update the game, so we're not done yet!
The random option for both game reviews and NPC platform popularity has been reworked to give players more options and variation in each new game they start.

For reviews you can now have a random factor of +/- 3%, 6%, 9% or 12% on all your game reviews. This can add a bit more variety to your game reviews, sometimes working in your advantage, sometimes not.

For platforms, options of +/- 25%, 50%, 75% and 100% (100% will be totally random, as it worked before not a +/- % increase) of the standard NPC platform sales have been added. This will alter the successful platforms you have to release your games on and compete against with your own consoles. Making some platforms more popular, and others less popular every new game.

(Update Jan 18th, 2024 - this has been changed in the latest patch to random platform popularity - low (+/-25%), medium (+/-50%), high (+/-75) and full (this will be the 100% totally random option). This was changed for better user clarity)

New Sandbox options have been added, bringing the total sandbox choices for the player to nearly 50! With many of these options having further options so that players can fine tune their game to play exactly the way they want.

It is now possible to set the working speed of employees in sandbox mode. With this setting you can increase (or decrease) the work speed of employees making them complete task much faster. While this will change the balance of the game, it will also make it possible to have much smaller teams of employees accomplish similar task of large teams. Increase your indie studio feel!

You can also change the quality of NPC game releases. This will allow you to play on easy with the NPC releasing top tier games, or on legendary difficulty with competition releasing much worse games and a whole host of options in-between.
And the option to set the maximum number of staff applications was added as well.

These options continue to push forward the ‘freedom of choice’ to play your way we have intended to give players since adding the sandbox mode. We don’t want you to just have unlimited money and call that a sandbox mode. We want you to be able to experiment, play, and even break the balance of the game however you would like. Whether that is the super easy, or the near impossible!

Subsidiaries have gotten some attention. We have added 3 additional IP focuses for them, and a few new sorting options to make it easier to tell which are your successful subsidiaries and which are your money pits!
Throughout the game there have been numerous ‘quality of life’ additions, new filters, additional information added to tool tips, search functions, menu and change save states, and more.

One of the larger quality of life changes is the ability to specify automatic research across all categories, this was added a few patches ago but now lets the player have much more control over what research they want to automate.
20 additional save slots were added by request for players who like to have multiple games or multiple saves of the same game going with less limitation.
And numerous bug, balance fixes and more.
As always, you can find a full list of all the recent changes in the patch notes below or the latest up to date patch notes on the steam discussion forum.
As stated above, we still have some upcoming updates and we have a list of feedback already gathered from players we continue to utilize to see what is possible but more feedback is always welcome!
Feel free to participate in our community and let us know what you think!

Perspectives, suggestions, general feedback and the overall support from the community has driven forward the game as it nears the 3rd year anniversary from Early Access in January 21, 2021, to it’s full release in May of last year.
So again, we would like to say thank you to everyone! And lets make 2024 another great year for Mad Games Tycoon 2!

Hello everyone!

It's been about 3 months since the full release of Mad Games Tycoon 2. In that time, the game has received over 500 reviews on Steam, with the vast majority being positive, and we're very happy with the response and support the game has received from the players!
We continue to update the game, adding new suggestions, tweaks, and additions to make the game experience that much better!
Today we are releasing another update, which you can find the details below along with a list of all the changes over the last couple months.
Many of the changes and additions throughout our early access journey came from player feedback and we are still seeking that feedback for things we can improve even after early access has ended.

We've recently opened up a new thread on the Steam discussion forums to collect suggestions to polish the game further, but you're also welcome to post your own threads with your ideas as we continue to monitor for feedback.
And of course, any bugs you may find please let us know so we can fix them ASAP!
So join the discussion, make a post, reply here, or leave a review and let us know what you think!

Hello everyone! We hope you've been continuing to enjoy playing Mad Games Tycoon 2!

Since our last Steam notification update, there have been tons of changes, tweaks, and improvements to the game. In this post we will highlight some of the most notable changes over the last several months of updates. As always, you'll find the latest and most up to date list of changes on the Steam discussion forum in the patch notes thread and at the end of this post will be a full list of changes.
Also, stay tuned for an announcement soon on Mad Games Tycoon 2 leaving Early Access!
So over the last couple months some of the most notable changes include -

Create upgraded versions of your existing consoles! You can develop and release enhanced versions (pro, slim etc) of your current consoles. This allows you to extend the life span of your aging consoles and give them a boost in sales and performance. Many new console cases were also added to enhance this feature.
Copying and pasting of rooms! You can now copy and paste existing rooms to create multiple rooms of the same type and layout, or rearrange your studio in a snap.

Buying and selling of IPs If you need some extra cash, or if there is an IP you would really like to own you have the option to buy and sell IPs. This is in addition to the already existing feature allowing you to transfer IPs from subsidiaries you own.
Release your game as Freeware Releasing your game as freeware can give you a lot of goodwill with fans, increasing their following of your studio and helping future releases sell more.

Game performance improvements Significant work has been done improving the game performance, with the game going through multiple performance improvement passes to make for a smoother experience when playing. Additionally, many new options have been added so you can adjust the game performance further.

Multiplayer improvements The multiplayer lobby has been revised, you can now buy companies in multiplayer, it's possible to sabotage other players, players can go bankrupt and experience negative effects due to bankruptcy. Many bug fixes and other QoL improvements to multiplayer also.

New music and game variety 10 new soundtracks have been added to the game, 144 new in-game screenshots have been added, 500 new game names and a new system to add more variety to spin-off titles has been implemented as well.
A new map! The Lagoon City map has been added to the game. This unique map surrounded by water brings the total choice of maps to 6.
Balance improvements The game has received balance improvements on all difficulty levels, and many of the game's features have been tweaked and balanced to create a better experience for players.

Bug fixes, Quality of Life improvements and more! There have been dozens and dozens of bug fixes, quality of life improvements, new options, adjustments to existing menus and features to make the game more user friendly and enjoyable to play. You'll find the full list below with details of every change in the patch notes.

notes.title: A summary of recent & latest changes

items.text: A lot of work has been put into the game since the last Steam notification update! As always, you can find the latest patch notes in the Steam discussion forum. This is the easiest and fastest way to stay up to date with the development of the game.
Here is a summary of some of the key changes with the full notes listed below!

Sandbox Mode! - A much requested feature! It is now possible to start the game in sandbox mode (Selected under 'game modes'), with this game mode you will have unlimited funds and begin the game with just about everything unlocked (that is currently available in your starting year) and ready to develop with! Achievements in this mode are disabled.

Automatic Room Furnishing and Decorating - Now when building a room, or remodeling an existing room you have the option to allow the game to automatically place the necessary items, work stations and decorations for that room! This was another highly requested addition that should save players a lot of time when playing.

A New Genre - Survival Game & 48 New Topics - You can develop games based on the Survival genre (Available in the mid 1980s) and there are 48 new topics to build your games around! These topics include things like Court Cases, Hotels, Restaurants, Multiple different ancient civilizations and more!

New Starting Options - When you start a new game you can now choose between standard development times, or realistic development times. With realistic development times, games will take considerably longer to develop. Additionally, you now have the option to choose any year between 1976 and 2020 to begin your new game!
9 New Publishers/Developers - New Publishers/Developers have been added to the game, along with their IPs. Adding extra competition to the game, and new companies that you can buy and take over!

Additional Control Over Your Subsidiaries - You can now see the exact game that your companies have in development, view the full development report of the game and cancel the game they are working on if you decide you want them working on something else.

MMO & F2P Marketshare Improvements - The market for both MMOs & F2P is now based on how many players have access to the internet in that given year. You can see this percentage through Market Research and the number will grow as the years advance.

Overall Game Performance Improvements - Multiple updates to improve the performance of the game, the pathfinding (more about that below) and make the game more stable as the years go by and your company grows!

Tons of Quality of Life, Tweaks and Additions to Existing Features, New Items, Balance Changes and A.I Improvements - You can see the full list below, but many menus have additional filters, easier access and other tweaks. Collision boxes on some items have been improved. New items such as Luxury Toilets and Modern Heating. The development time, game size requirements (A, B, etc) and requirements to get quality reviews have all been better balanced.: The A.I for both employees, and competitors has been improved, with your employees making smarter decisions when fulfilling needs and their pathfinding being improved (Work on this is ongoing).: Competing NPC companies make additional use of ports (from Arcades -> PC/Consoles), have had their Arcade sales numbers boosted and more.: Employees now request salary improvements through negotiations as they become better skilled.: You have the option to charge for customer support in the Support Room now, there are additional statistics for merchandising in the Fan Shop and many more quality of life improvements, tweaks and much more listed in the patch notes below!

And there are still more changes in the works! Console Creation/Development still has improvements and changes coming. Game Pass is still coming to the game. Multiplayer will have performance improvements and additional options/features added plus other unannounced changes and suggestions from the community!
And of course continuing to do more bug fixes, quality of life changes, performance improvements and balance changes to create the most fun and smooth gameplay experience possible!
Thank you for supporting the game! All the reviews, suggestions, bug reports and feedback has continued to push the game to be better and better!

Summer Update!
With summer coming to a close we wanted to post an update letting players know the changes that have been made in the previous weeks and months.

The game continues to progress, adding more features, gameplay improvements and request from players. We are very happy with the success and support we have received through this Early Access process and we hope you are enjoying the journey as well!

There have been over 24 patches/updates since the last posted notification - these patch notes are regularly posted on the Steam discussion forums with every patch but here are some of the highlighted changes -

Game design settings (sliders) now factor in both the main genre and the sub-genre. Taking the previous 18 perfect genre settings and now making the combinations nearly 300! This will increase the variety of game designs allowing you to make more unique games and the usefulness of game reports from the Q&A department.

There are now new events! Your games can become surprise hits, commercial failures or have bugs show up after release. Taking your time to polish your game before releasing it can help you avoid bugs after release!
It's now possible to publish games for other companies. You can negotiate terms and release these games through your production facilities earning a profit on their work!

When a game is in development you can now add additional new features to it, and once completed you will have the option to set aside the game to publish it at a later date rather than having to publish it immediately.

Many background changes to improve game performance, the A.I and Multiplayer have been made. The A.I now is both more competitive and creates a larger variety of game types with near parity of all the choices the player has to create games.: Multiplayer has had data synchronization added making it more stable and much more difficult to cheat. Additionally several other multiplayer bugs have been fixed and the ability to share console research between players has been added.

In the marketing department you can now perform a staff search! Need a programmer, or a game designer and there isn't one available? Start a search for the specific employee you need!: This is along with dozens of other changes that also include larger impact of 'Trendsetting' games, new publishers and developers, the ability to create 1st party manufacturer exclusive games for your own consoles, a reworking of the banking and loan system, changes to certain ways you gain fans along with the impact your fans have on sales and a continued ongoing focus on quality of life improvements and balancing existing features.: And there is still more to come! Please keep the feedback, suggestions, reviews and bug reports coming - they are much appreciated!
